T often passive: › [ T often passive ] to force someone to leave a particular place
T: › [ T ] US UK send off to order a sports player to leave the playing area during a game because they have broken a rule
將（犯規的運動員）罰下場
I: › [ I ] to leave an aircraft in an emergency using an ejection seat
（緊急情況下連坐椅一起從飛機中）彈射出來
I or T: › [ I or T ] to come out of a machine when a button is pressed, or to make something do this

example: A number of fans had been ejected from the bar for causing trouble.
一些足球迷因爲鬧事被趕出酒吧。
How do you eject the tape?
怎樣才能把磁帶彈出來？
The coffee machine suddenly ejected a handful of coins.
咖啡自動售賣機裡突然彈出一把硬幣。

NONE: › the act of ejecting someone or something
› a seat that can throw out the person flying an aircraft if they suddenly have to leave it because they are in danger
（危急情況下將人從飛機中彈出的）彈射座椅
